dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a conventional housing loan for a home purchase. Could you please tell me the status or outcome of my application?

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. What is the interest rate for my loan, and are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags associated with it?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 10.5%. It is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and there are no negative amortization features associated with your loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the details. That interest rate seems quite high—can you tell me what my total loan costs will be? Also, has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution since approval?

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying. Could you please confirm my loan term as recorded in your system? And can you tell me what my debt-to-income (DTI) ratio was for this application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan term is recorded as 360 months. The debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is not listed in your loan record, so I do not have that information available.
